reconcile-check with persist=False must not create get_rotation.json sidecar on pre-migration stores
git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE must be explicitly staged and basename-checked in reconcile_helpers.py to ensure commit without git add -A
Extracted get_rotation.py module must remain cohesive rotation state boundary and keep outbound_differ.py and binding_store.py at or below 800-line module-size policy
